## Description

Applies the randomized matrix pencil method to extract exact generalized eigenvalues and damping factors from cross-asset price series, identifying ultra-fast lead-lag relationships.

## Where it may fit

E-mini S&P vs sector ETF baskets, index futures vs cash arbitrage, fragmented liquidity transmission.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Statistical Arbitrage Desks.

## Required data

Synchronized sub-second quote and trade tick streams across correlated instruments.

## Caveats

SVD tolerance thresholds must be adjusted dynamically to prevent noise-induced false pencil poles.
